scope: Approved reviewed AU-to-AV design transition for fixture promotion; not a manufacturing or flight release.

control_regression.scope: Both saved documents exercised under the currently loaded AV validator; this is a control regression check, not an execution of archived AU source.

semantic_expected_changes.main_metadata_only_horn: StarboardServoHorn: added cart source and explicitly qualified drawing correspondence; native shape and placement unchanged.
semantic_expected_changes.main_carrier_changes: Plain decks remove tie slots; common 20 mm square M2 clearance pattern on all three carriers and additional 30.5 mm M3 on electronics. Support deck bottom rises 10.2 to 11.4 mm; top rises 12.2 to 13.4 mm. Existing rail mating geometry and carrier XY extents remain unchanged.
semantic_expected_changes.maximum_battery_envelope: Old local Shape bottom 11 mm plus Placement Z 2.2 mm gave world bottom 13.2 mm. New local Shape bottom 14.4 mm and Placement Z 0 give world bottom 14.4 mm. This is exactly the intended 1.2 mm world translation, with coordinate representation normalized.
semantic_expected_changes.main_registry_and_controls: No added or removed main objects, no changed registry membership or expressions; both saved documents pass the current AV native control regression and have equal control behavior.
semantic_expected_changes.unchanged_mechanisms: Rail, propulsion fixed frame, servo bridge, horns/adapters, gears, shafts, bearings and propulsor rotation geometry are unchanged. Optical moving geometry is unchanged except the complete installed elevation change.
semantic_expected_changes.optional_plan: TETHER_DUAL_BEC becomes TETHER_BEC_SVPDB: one BEC12S-PRO set to 8 V feeds FC/main supply and the SVPDB-8S input; one SVPDB-8S set to 5 V supplies the separate servo rail. The serialized plan records branch input topology. No second BEC or 5.2 V SVPDB setting is asserted.
semantic_expected_changes.optional_platform: Plain deck, no tie slots or tether departure feature; common 20 mm M2 and 30.5 mm M3 patterns rotate 35 degrees. Whole installed tower raises 1.2 mm with its carrier; foot hardware and first BEC geometry otherwise unchanged.
semantic_expected_changes.optional_context: All 113 saved context shapes match corresponding new main world shapes exactly.
semantic_expected_changes.nonfunctional_metadata: Rebuilt App::Part Uids differ. Styled AU versus raw pre-preview AV optional visibility differs. P-AS clearance 4.0 to 3.9999999999999982 mm is numeric representation noise. These do not change physical geometry or control behavior.
semantic_expected_changes.release_scope: Both releases retain fit-prototype status, production_released false and the same 18 unresolved-interface keys. This audit does not promote assumed hardware dimensions or qualify print fit, loaded stiffness, clamp creep, electrical loads, flight readiness or optional tether loading.

reviewer: Independent subagent /root/au_horn; no CAD, fixture or production source written by this review.
